name: Slovenia — Slovenian parties
intro: compare it with Slovenian political parties
inclusion_note: The test includes the main national parties of Slovenia: those represented in the parliament (Državni zbor) and those with a significant national following. Positions are the team's estimates and are open to review.
hemicycle_note: Seats in the parliament (Državni zbor) after the 2022 election, arranged left to right. Approximate. 90 members. A more recent election is not yet reflected in these seats; the party list includes parties that are strong in current polls. Parties shown without seats are included because they poll strongly.

Levica.name: Levica
Levica.priorities: Affordable housing, Public services, Workers' rights and wages
Levica.description: The Left, a democratic-socialist party in the governing coalition since 2022.

SD.name: Socialni demokrati
SD.priorities: Welfare state, Pensions and the elderly, Workers' rights and wages
SD.description: Social Democrats, in the governing coalition since 2022.

GS.name: Gibanje Svoboda
GS.priorities: Climate action, Public healthcare, Rule of law
GS.description: Freedom Movement of Robert Golob, a liberal green party that won the 2022 election by a wide margin.

Volt.name: Volt Slovenija
Volt.priorities: Deeper European integration, Climate action, Digital innovation, Democratic reform
Volt.description: National chapter of Volt Europa, the first pan-European party. All chapters share one programme: a federal and more democratic EU, evidence-based policy, a market economy with a strong welfare state, and the digital and climate transitions. Volt has the same positions in every country in this test.

NSi.name: Nova Slovenija
NSi.priorities: Traditional family values, Lower taxes, Competitiveness and growth

Demokrati.name: Demokrati Anžeta Logarja
Demokrati.priorities: Competitiveness and growth, Rule of law
Demokrati.description: The Democrats of Anže Logar, a centre-right party founded in 2024 by a former SDS minister.

SDS.name: Slovenska demokratska stranka
SDS.priorities: Reducing immigration, Security and law and order, National identity
SDS.description: Slovenian Democratic Party of former prime minister Janez Janša, the largest opposition party; right-wing populist though a member of the EPP.

Resni.ca.name: Resni.ca
Resni.ca.priorities: National sovereignty, Diplomacy with Russia, no arms deliveries, Democratic reform
Resni.ca.description: Resni.ca ('Truth'), an anti-establishment party that grew out of opposition to COVID measures.
